observations: Photo 0: black UPS unit with 'BLUE GATE' branding embossed on top, blue vertical strip with power button and three indicator lights (labeled with small icons, not clearly readable)
Photo 1: same unit from a rear/side angle showing a power cable with a UK-style 3-pin plug, unit resting on tiled floor
No visible model number, VA/capacity rating, or label with specifications in either photo
No battery compartment, cables (output sockets), or rear panel with ports/ratings shown
Unit appears used, with some surface scuffing and dust
No photo of unit powered on, no display of charge/load, no indication of battery health

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show a UPS unit branded Blue Gate

risks.risk: Battery health/capacity unknown — UPS batteries degrade and a unit could fail to hold charge
risks.proof: Video of unit powered on, running a load, and sustaining power after mains is cut
risks.if_unproven: priced as battery not holding charge / needing replacement

risks.risk: No VA/wattage rating visible, which determines what it can power and its market value
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rating label (usually on side or back) showing VA/Watt capacity
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest common capacity for unbranded/generic small UPS of this size

risks.risk: Output sockets and rear panel condition unknown (could be damaged, missing covers, or non-functional ports)
risks.proof: Photo of rear panel showing output sockets and any switches
risks.if_unproven: priced as if sockets condition unverified/possibly faulty

risks.risk: Overall functional status (does it turn on, charge, alarm properly) unverified
risks.proof: Short video clip powering it on and showing LED behavior per the seller's description

risks.risk: Age/usage history unknown; UPS units lose battery life over years even if cosmetically fine
risks.proof: Any purchase date, sticker date code, or seller statement on age (photo of date label if present)

proof_requests: Photo of the rating label (VA/Watt, model number) usually on the side or bottom
Video of the UPS powered on, charging, and holding a connected load after mains is unplugged
Photo of the rear panel with output sockets and ports
Any info on age or purchase date of the unit
response.reason: The UPS brand is identifiable but no capacity/VA rating, model number, or functional proof is visible in the photos, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without this missing label and power-on evidence.
